use_case: AI estimating and bid assistant: quantity takeoff from drawings, pricing from the group historical cost database, subcontractor bid leveling and recommendations, and proposal drafting
vendor_or_model: AI estimating SaaS vendor (computer vision takeoff plus a generative language model with retrieval over the group cost database), enterprise tenant
data_categories: Drawings and specifications (FCI on awarded federal contracts; CUI prohibited); historical costs and bid pricing; subcontractor bids and contacts
consequential_decision_category: None directly (business decisions about bids and subcontractors); re-tier to Employment or Safety/CI if used for hiring, crew assignment, or life-safety quantities
human_in_the_loop: Estimator verifies every major-trade takeoff and records the reason for each subcontractor selection; the preconstruction lead approves every bid and signs any federal price certification
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) and DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2) (FCI only on approved systems; no CUI); FAR 52.203-2 independent price determination; FAR 15.403-4 certified cost or pricing data when required; FAR 52.219-8 small business participation policy; Sherman Act Sec. 1 (counsel); FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production with conditions (about 640 Construction estimators and 85 A&E cost estimators); A&E federal uploads blocked (POAM-025); expansion paused

use_case: Jobsite safety computer vision: detects missing PPE, exclusion-zone entries, and fall hazards from jobsite cameras and alerts the site safety manager
vendor_or_model: Jobsite camera service vendor's analytics feature
data_categories: Video of workers and visitors at jobsites
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI; Employment if alerts were used for discipline (prohibited)
human_in_the_loop: Safety manager reviews every alert and decides the response; alerts never trigger discipline; the tool does not replace required inspections
applicable_laws: OSHA duties stay with the employer (no OSHA AI rule); state employee monitoring and notice laws (counsel; generic); Texas TRAIGA intent-based prohibitions (Tex. Bus. & Com. Code ch. 551-554) at Texas jobsites; collective bargaining agreements where they apply
status: Pilot at 40 jobsites; written use limitation (safety only, no discipline) issued 2026-09; expansion requires the conditions in section 6

use_case: AI resume screening and ranking for craft hiring
vendor_or_model: Applicant tracking vendor's AI ranking module
data_categories: Applicant resumes, work history, certifications, location
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters review every application; the ranking may not be used to reject an applicant until the conditions in section 6 are met
applicable_laws: Title VII disparate impact (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k)) still applies by statute even though EEOC guidance was removed and enforcement deprioritized (EO 14281); ADA accommodation duties; Texas TRAIGA intent-based prohibitions; no Colorado, Illinois, New York City, or Connecticut hiring (SB26-189, HB 3773, LL 144, and PA 26-15 not applicable; revisit on entry)
status: Pilot paused for rejection decisions; ranking shown to recruiters as advisory only in 2 regions

use_case: Generative design assistant producing space-planning and massing options from program requirements
vendor_or_model: Design software vendor's generative design module
data_categories: Client program data and commercial designs; no CUI permitted
consequential_decision_category: None; re-tier to Safety/CI if used for structural or life-safety design
human_in_the_loop: Architect or engineer of record selects, edits, and takes responsibility for every option; AI-generated elements labeled; checklist at sealing
applicable_laws: State architecture and engineering licensing rules on responsible charge (generic); client contracts; POL-04 4.13 (no CUI)

use_case: Code compliance checking assistant that flags building code issues (egress, fire separation, accessibility) in design models
vendor_or_model: Code checking vendor with a language model layer
data_categories: Design models; adopted code editions; no CUI permitted
human_in_the_loop: Licensed code reviewers perform the full required review; the tool's flags are a second check, and a clean result never replaces review
applicable_laws: State licensing rules (generic); adopted building codes; client contracts; POL-04 4.13
status: Pilot on 20 commercial projects; advisory only

use_case: Lease abstraction: extracts critical dates, options, and obligations from commercial leases
human_in_the_loop: Lease administrators verify every critical date and option before it enters the lease system
applicable_laws: Contract confidentiality; FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production; dual verification of critical dates

use_case: BAS energy optimization: adjusts heating, cooling, and ventilation setpoints within limits to cut energy use
vendor_or_model: BAS analytics vendor (cloud service connected to supervisory servers)
data_categories: Building telemetry and setpoints; occupancy schedules
affects_individuals: Yes (building occupants' comfort and air quality)
human_in_the_loop: The service writes setpoints directly within bounds set in the vendor service; building engineers can disable it per building; no access to life-safety interfaces. Controller-level limits the AI cannot override are a condition (section 6)
applicable_laws: Group building systems standard (POL-01 4.13); ventilation requirements in applicable building and mechanical codes (generic); leases
status: In production at 8 properties; no expansion until building network segmentation (POAM-022) at those properties

use_case: AP invoice and payment anomaly detection: flags unusual invoices, bank changes, and payment patterns for review
affects_individuals: Yes (vendors and subcontractors whose payments are held)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (payment holds); a human releases or rejects
human_in_the_loop: AP analysts review every flag; holds are released or confirmed within 2 business days so subcontractors are not paid late
applicable_laws: FAR 52.232-27(c) prompt payment of subcontractors on federal jobs; POL-01 4.15
status: In production in the payment factory; Property AP added with POAM-031

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting, summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant with no-training and retention terms
data_categories: Internal documents; FCI only for approved roles in the enterprise tenant; CUI, bid pricing on federal bids, and Social Security numbers prohibited
human_in_the_loop: Users review outputs; prohibited for hiring, safety, code compliance, or federal pricing decisions
